body: The dynamic mapping docs are correct, but I can see how you could misread it.  Dynamic field mappings are only added when a field contains a concrete value: we don't add one when the field contains `null` or an empty array.  Pinging the docs team to see if they want to clarify it a bit.

issue.title: [DOCS]  Clarify that `null` values don't create dynamic field mappings
